author: HBO Max
description:
On Season 2, Episode 2 of DC Studios Showcase: The Official Podcast, hosts Frankey and Coy sit down with Jason Momoa for one of the most chaotic and hype conversations yet. From the second he texted “Lobo” to James Gunn after the DC Studios announcement to the first time he saw himself fully transformed into the Main Man.

Jason talks exclusive behind-the-scenes details about becoming Lobo in DC Studios’ upcoming Supergirl, the unforgettable first day riding the Space Hog, and why this has been his dream comic book role since childhood. Plus, Frankey drinks her first Guinness ever with Jason Momoa, and somehow the Fast & Furious franchise gets connected to the DC Universe. Supergirl hits theaters June 26 – tickets now available.
